capabilities: Hold agent writes in a pending queue with before/after diffs
Re-read and hash-verify targets before applying approved writes
Snapshot accepted changes and roll them back
Record and export a searchable change timeline as JSON or CSV
Expose 14 MCP tools for agent context, search, notes, memos, tasks and changes
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly): client setup, snapshots and uninstall use Node fs. Not a sandbox: an agent with direct filesystem access outside Sediment can still edit notes. Timeline is bounded by retained tool calls (500) and snapshots (200), so regular exports are needed for a permanent record. File bridge for non-MCP agents, poster export and art-style switching are experimental and off by default. The manifest description emphasizes a knowledge dashboard with heatmaps, memos and weekly reviews; the README positions those as supporting views for the write-audit core. Setup and threat-model docs live in examples/ (SECURE-AGENT-SETUP.md, AGENTS.md, Claude Code skill).
intentEvidence: its own docs call it a review aid, not a complete audit
motivation: A chat diff vanishes on restart, doesn't record shell changes, and never tells the agent you revoked something.
problem: Agent edits to the vault leave no durable record of what changed, whether it was approved, or how to undo it.
